title: Your app is deleting previously earned achievement progress
body:
Device: iPhone 16 Pro Max
OS: iOS 26, latest version

I had already unlocked the “365 completed goals” achievement about six months ago and was progressing toward “500 completed goals.” I should currently be at roughly 400/500, but the app now shows only 177/365. A substantial amount of my recorded progress has been deleted without any action on my part.
This is a serious data integrity issue. Previously earned achievements and completed goals must not disappear.
There is also a separate bug with percentage-based achievements (200%, 300%, 400%). The app sometimes fails to award them when the required percentage is reached. They may appear hours/days later, or not at all. In some cases, reinstalling the app has been the only way to make them appear.
Please investigate the achievement/progress synchronization and data storage logic, restore my lost progress if possible, and prevent this from happening again.
author: Dmytro Tukalo

title: Broken streak tracking and no support available
body:
I’ve been using Apple Fitness and this is not the first time I’ve encountered a serious issue.

My longest activity streak keeps resetting even though all workouts are completed. Calorie and activity data are inaccurate, which makes the statistics unreliable and frustrating.

This is not a one-time glitch — it happens repeatedly.

What’s even more frustrating is that Apple support is essentially unavailable. The only option is to contact by phone, but no matter what time I try, it says the option is not available.

As a result, there is no way to get help or resolve the issue.

I expect these bugs to be fixed and proper support to be available.

title: Не працює
body:

Також мені сподобалась ідея з винагородами/медалями, але вони працювали якийсь час, а потім зламались. Деякі зависли на результаті якій ти зробив два тижні тому, а деякі зависли у процесі і перестали нараховувати статистику і ти не можеш їх отримати.

title: There is no fitness+ for Ukraine
body:
It’s a nice app to monitor daily activities and training sessions. But in Ukraine we can’t use such a cool feature as a fitness+. We have a pandemic with different restrictions all over the world and now here is the war in Ukraine, as a result many Ukrainian people cannot attend gyms to maintain their health. So it would be great if we get an access to fitness+ to have training session at places which we call homes now, besides Ukrainians uses subscription AppleOne which includes payment for fitness+.
It is also worth to say that in the country that attacked Ukraine, fitness + has been working for a long time already…
